notes: Sourced from AMX's official NX-2200 datasheet (Rev 11.18.16, copyright 2016 Harman) - the manufacturer's PDF, fetched via the amx.com product_documents redirect to adn.harmanpro.com. All Ethernet ports (LAN, ICSLAN) are 10/100 only (eth-100m); no Gigabit support. All control I/O (AxLink, RS-232/422/485, RS-232 x3, I/O, Relay) use 3.5mm mini-Phoenix pluggable screw terminals of varying pin counts - mapped to the closest available connector id 'euroblock' since a dedicated screw-terminal id isn't in the allowed list; actual pin counts (2/4/6/8/10-position) are noted per port. The 4 IR/Serial ports are 1-way IR transmit or serial output only (not full duplex serial) and use 2-position screw terminals, not mini-jack IR connectors - mapped to 'ir' as the closest semantic match, exact physical connector noted. The unit has no internal AC inlet; it is powered by an external DC power supply (PSN6.5 or PSR5.4, sold separately/optional) via a 2-pin 3.5mm Phoenix DC terminal block, mapped to 'euroblock-dc'. No grade applies to any of the screw-terminal/serial/relay/IR/AxLink ports per the grading rules (analog/control connectors are excluded from grading). USB Program and Host ports are treated as USB 2.0 speed (medium confidence on that specific grade - the datasheet doesn't explicitly state 'USB 2.0' but Standard-A/B connectors on this device generation are USB 2.0). Physical dimensions: 1RU, 17in x 9.125in x 1.75in, 6.08 lb.

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: 10/100 RJ-45, connects master to external/primary network (Dual NIC design)

ports.name: ICSLAN
ports.note: 10/100 RJ-45, isolated secondary network for AMX/third-party A/V device control

ports.name: AxLink
ports.note: 4-position 3.5mm screw terminal (mini-Phoenix); provides data and power to external AxLink control devices

ports.name: RS-232/422/485 (Port 1)
ports.note: 10-position 3.5mm screw terminal (mini-Phoenix); NetLinx Port 1; selectable RS-232/422/485, 300-115200 baud

ports.name: RS-232 (Port 2)
ports.note: 2-position 3.5mm screw terminal (mini-Phoenix); NetLinx Port 2; RS-232 only, 300-115200 baud

ports.name: RS-232 (Port 3)
ports.note: 2-position 3.5mm screw terminal (mini-Phoenix); NetLinx Port 3; RS-232 only, 300-115200 baud

ports.name: RS-232 (Port 4)
ports.note: 2-position 3.5mm screw terminal (mini-Phoenix); NetLinx Port 4; RS-232 only, 300-115200 baud

ports.name: IR/Serial (Port 11)
ports.note: 2-position 3.5mm screw terminal; 1-way IR/Serial transmit, NetLinx Port 11, carriers up to 1.142 MHz. Closest connector id chosen; actual physical connector is a 3.5mm screw terminal, not a mini-jack IR emitter connector

ports.name: IR/Serial (Port 12)
ports.note: 2-position 3.5mm screw terminal; 1-way IR/Serial transmit, NetLinx Port 12, carriers up to 1.142 MHz

ports.name: IR/Serial (Port 13)
ports.note: 2-position 3.5mm screw terminal; 1-way IR/Serial transmit, NetLinx Port 13, carriers up to 1.142 MHz

ports.name: IR/Serial (Port 14)
ports.note: 2-position 3.5mm screw terminal; 1-way IR/Serial transmit, NetLinx Port 14, carriers up to 1.142 MHz

ports.name: I/O (Port 22, Channels 1-4)
ports.note: Single 6-position 3.5mm screw terminal providing 4-channel binary I/O for contact closure with voltage sensing, NetLinx Port 22

ports.name: Relay (Port 21, Channels 1-4)
ports.note: Single 8-position 3.5mm screw terminal, 4 SPST relays, each switches up to 24 VDC or 28 VAC @ 1A, NetLinx Port 21

ports.name: USB Host (Front)
ports.note: USB Standard A host port on front panel; supports flash/SSD for firmware, code files, config backup

ports.name: USB Host (Rear)
ports.note: USB Standard A host port on rear panel; supports flash/SSD for firmware, code files, config backup

ports.name: PWR
ports.note: 2-pin 3.5mm mini-Phoenix DC power terminal block; 9-18 VDC range, 12 VDC typical, 250 mA @ 12 VDC; used with external PSN6.5/PSR5.4 power supply (no internal AC/IEC inlet)
